address: 2F, Azabudai Hills Residence A, 1-2-3 Azabudai, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 106-0041, Japan
bio: DepTH brianza explores concepts that broaden the possibilities of Italian cuisine. Chef Okuno’s latest culinary adventure is a taste test that takes Italian cuisine a little outside its comfort zone. While firmly grounded in tradition, Okuno enjoys reframing Japanese ingredients in creative ways. ‘DepTH’ is a play on his name: ‘okuyuki’ is ‘depth’ in Japanese. Like a wizard reworking ancient spells, Okuno dreams up imaginative cuisine you won’t find anywhere else....
